what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 157912 refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the largest share, 28.6%, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in many years from 1979, most recently with Jaish al-Adl from 2023 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iran from 1979 to 1988 and in later years, with the KDPI in 2016 and 2018.
An interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel is recorded from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1980 at 48 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 158171, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1985 to 1986, 1991 to 2006 and 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, and the data shows several large jumps in the 1980s.
